experiment: P2x ISRJ sample-width phase-reset-sequence OOD identifiability
research_question: Does the instantaneous-frequency reset interval of the exact ISRJ component recover sample width across ID and OOD intervals, including the 1-2 us boundary regime where maximum-prominence ACF failed?

parameter_contract.valid_mask: label[ISRJ]=1 AND parameter_mask[53]=1 AND finite target

estimator.feature: wrapped second difference of complex phase on active adjacent samples
estimator.event_clustering: merge consecutive reset samples, then use cluster centres
estimator.selection: integer mode of adjacent reset-cluster gaps; ties are resolved closest to the gap median then by smaller lag
estimator.fallback: 12.5 microseconds when no valid reset gap exists

baselines_and_controls.C0_constant: 12.5 microseconds fixed from the original 5-20 us training interval
baselines_and_controls.C2_raw_phase_reset: same estimator on compound received IQ, diagnostic only
baselines_and_controls.C3_time_shuffled_exact: deterministically shuffled exact component, mechanism destruction control

interpretation.pass: The phase-reset sequence supplies a physical oracle upper bound; next test component isolation on a new identity seed.
interpretation.fail: The reset-sequence mechanism is insufficient; stop ISRJ-width expert development and retain the failure boundary.
